title: Sounding
summary: SOUND'ING, participle present tense 1. Causing to sound; uttering audibly. 2. Trying the depth of water by the plummet; examining the intention or will. 3. adjective Sonorous; making a noise. 4. Havin

inlines.v: SOUND'ING, participle present tense 1. Causing to sound; uttering audibly. 2. Trying the depth of water by the plummet; examining the intention or will. 3. adjective Sonorous; making a noise. 4. Having a magnificent sound; as words more sounding or significant. SOUND'ING, noun 1. The act of uttering noise; the act or endeavoring to discover the opinion or desires; the act of throwing the lead. 2. In surgery, the operation of introducing the sound into the bladder; called searching for the stone.
